body: How can someone reproduce the issue you're having?

I'm seeing this issue too after updating from v3.3.15 to v3.4.2, with `tmp_name` getting passed to `Validation::extension()` as the `$check` arg causing validation to fail. Quick and dirty way to reproduce: add a `debug($check)` [here](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/3.4.2/src/Validation/Validation.php#L693) and upload a file with the rule enabled.

I gather that you are using the extension rule as a validator on a file upload field then? Assuming the first key will be the filename seems like a fragile assumption. I will make the method more robust.

Yes, on a file upload field as I did assume that was the intent of the validation rule (without really confirming though). I would think others would assume the same, and it did work as expected for file fields in 3.3.x. Thanks for looking into this.

issue.body:
Accept FILES data that has shuffled keys. Relying on key order in an associative array is fragile. I've also added tests for some of the more curious behaviors Validation::extension() has.

Refs #10267
